close_reason: Doc-only fix in commit 51b6255. Added inline reconnect/resume reminders at copy-pasteable spots inside the example loop (subscribe_events / connect_ws call sites + inner loop). Also fixed an incidental spec citation typo in ws_loop.rs ('RFC 8887 §4.3.5.1' -> '§4.3.5'). cargo build --examples + clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings green.
description: examples/ws_loop.rs. The base-client connect_ws doc-comment (ws/mod.rs:344) explicitly says 'The caller is responsible for reconnecting after disconnect with exponential backoff.' The example header (line 22) mentions 'single connection, no retry' but the body of the while-let loop (line 71) has no inline reminder. A downstream user copying just the loop loses the header context. Add a comment near line 71: '// Production: after next_chat_frame returns None or Err, reconnect with exponential backoff.' Also: line 39 cites 'RFC 8887 §4.3.5.1' — that subsection doesn't exist; should be §4.3.5.
title: examples/ws_loop.rs: no inline reminder about reconnect-with-backoff
